propositions: All in-tree structured-output consumers must route through a single PydanticAIRunner facade with one-operation Pydantic path as sole implementation
structured_retry_limit must be retained as output-retry-allowance cap, clamping both Agent retries and UsageLimits addend via single allowance N
structured_retry_limit=0 must yield zero output-repair retries (single-shot fail-safe), preserving overlap/judge.py and contracts.py batch abstain
Well-formed first responses trigger exactly one agent.run_sync invocation; bug-895c downgrade legitimizes exactly two (native then prompted); no third outer model run permitted
No bespoke fresh-Agent output-attempt loop remains; output repair is in-Agent bounded retry (retries={output:N}) not scheduler reconstruction
Provider fallback eligibility, tool limits, timeout/transport ownership, provenance, and serialized output shapes must remain stable across structured consumer suite
